grouping: source_id; no publication overlap; corpus, ranker and aggregation weights refit inside each outer training fold; the prior excludes the query publication by construction

hypotheses.F: A historical residual blended into the frontier reciprocal-rank base with weight lambda improves on the base; lambda=0 recovers the base exactly, so the blend must earn any movement.
hypotheses.L: Re-weighting individual experts and adding a small historical prior term inside the same reciprocal-rank aggregation improves on uniform weights.

provenance.base: reciprocal-rank fusion (constant 60) over the five expert files
provenance.input: pre-experimental metadata; train-union genes; no target library
provenance.input_contract: description metadata + separately generated zero-shot expert rankings; no target library
provenance.protocol: train <=2020; validation 2021; public test >=2022 already explored historically

selection: three publication-grouped folds inside the 1349 training screens; the single best configuration by pooled out-of-fold mean is confirmed once on the 2021 validation split
stochastic_training: deterministic LightGBM with fixed seed and full feature/row fractions; the aggregation search is deterministic coordinate ascent
